title: Parallelise internal/runstate's 84 serial tests (full suite 41s)
body:
x73 left runstate as a follow-on. Measured now: -short 6.5s (no gate win), full suite 41s with 84 serial top-level tests summing 39s. Only remote_flap_test.go and http_stall_test.go use t.Setenv; the rest just never call t.Parallel(). The win is go-touched's full-suite run on ticks that touch runstate, about 41s down to under 10s. Low: reconcile, which imports it, is left to CI, so A1 does not move.
evidence: go test -count=1 -parallel 12 -json ./internal/runstate/: wall 41s, serial tests 84 summing 39.35s
